2.title: Sen. Casey Welcomes WWII Rosies to U.S.  Capitol
2.description:
March 20, 2018- To celebrate “National Rosie the Riveter Day,” a day of recognition for the millions of women who worked to support the national effort during WWII, U.S. Sen. Bob Casey welcomed real-life 'Rosies' to the U.S. Capitol. 

The Casey-led bipartisan resolution, S.Res.418, expressing support for the designation of March 21, 2018, as "National Rosie the Riveter Day" passed the Senate by Unanimous Consent on February 28, 2018. Casey has also introduced bipartisan legislation, S.2500  that would honor the “Rosies” by presenting them with a Congressional Gold Medal, the highest civilian honor bestowed by Congress.

3.title: Sen. Casey Q&A with PA Witness at Hearing on Turning 65
3.description:
Jan. 24, 2018- U.S. Senator Bob Casey (D-PA), Ranking Member of the U.S. Senate Special Committee on Aging, held a hearing, “Turning 65: Navigating Critical Decisions to Age Well.” During the hearing, Sen. Casey pushed for passage of the Medicare Beneficiary Enrollment Notification and Eligibility Simplification (BENES) Act that would ensure adults approaching age 65 have essential information about Medicare enrollment. 

Watch the archived hearing here: https://www.aging.senate.gov/hearings/turning-65-navigating-critical-decisions-to-age-well

4.title: Sen. Casey Q&A with  Pittsburgh-Area Resident at Hearing on Senior Nutrition
4.description:
July 12, 2017- U.S. Senator Bob Casey (D-PA), Ranking Member of the U.S. Senate Special Committee on Aging, held a hearing, “Nourishing our Golden Years: How Proper and Adequate Nutrition Promote Healthy Aging and Positive Outcomes.” During the hearing, Sen. Casey participated in a q&a with Pat Taylor, a retired health care worker from Pennsylvania, on the importance of the Senior Food Box Program from her local community center. 

Watch the full hearing on senior nutrition: https://www.aging.senate.gov/hearings/nourishing-our-golden-years-how-proper-and-adequate-nutrition-promotes-healthy-aging-and-positive-outcomes 

Read the Nourishing Our Golden Years Act here: 
https://www.aging.senate.gov/press-releases/casey-collins-introduce-the-nourishing-our-golden-years-act

5.title: Sen. Casey and PA Attorney General Josh Shapiro at Robocalls Hearing

9.title: Sen. Casey Previews Hearing on the Effects of Social Isolation and Loneliness
9.description:
April 26, 2017-On Thursday, April 27, 2017, U.S. Senator Bob Casey (D-Pa.), Ranking Member of the U.S. Senate Special Committee on Aging will hold a hearing “Aging Without Community: the Consequences of Isolation and Loneliness.” The hearing will examine the consequences that social isolation and loneliness can have on older adults and those with disabilities, as well as examine resources and programs to reduce and prevent isolation.

Watch the live broadcast online.
https://www.aging.senate.gov/hearings/aging-without-community-the-consequences-of-isolation-and-loneliness-
